name: Klarix Intelligence API
description:
Public-web competitive intelligence for revenue teams: battlecards, ICP fit scoring, prospect lookalikes, and tech-stack teardowns.

Every factual claim carries a resolvable source URL. Where evidence is thin, the response says so instead of guessing. No emails, phone numbers, or licensed contact rows.

The same fifteen tools are available over MCP at https://mcp.klarix.ai/mcp. REST and MCP call identical functions, so output matches byte for byte. Full reference: https://klarix.ai/docs/api
